baselineOverride: Set FROST_TRAFFIC_SOURCE to simulation.js from referenceCommit

before.scope: QuickJS simulation CPU, first dense marching tick; 3 warmups and 10 independent scenes per size. Also one complete forty-unit mixed formation march. Excludes native rendering and IPC.

after.scope: QuickJS simulation CPU, first dense marching tick; 3 warmups and 10 independent scenes per size. Also one complete forty-unit mixed formation march. Excludes native rendering and IPC.

limitations: Local sequential diagnostic, not an exclusive-machine benchmark. First tick median: 3 warmups + 10 scenes per size; full 40-unit mixed march: one scene per version, both arrive at tick 235. Total march CPU is effectively unchanged; this reduces startup peaks. Excludes renderer, transport and physical input. Does not meet 5 ms target.
